summary_rationale: Apar Industries is a globally scaled, engineering-led industrial compounder holding #1 global share in aluminium/alloy conductors and top-3 global share in transformer oils, alongside a rapidly scaling specialty cables franchise (29.77% FY26 export mix; 11.0% Q2 FY27 cable EBITDA margin; ₹15,025 Cr+ combined Conductor and Cable order book including ~₹1,000 Cr Google/Amazon data-center wins; FY26 ROCE 32%, ROE 20.3%). Technical qualification moats (UL, IEC, IEEE, E-beam irradiation) and molten-metal adjacency at Jharsuguda underpin durable pricing power, while the August 2026 ₹2,500 Cr QIP (₹1,875 Cr earmarked for working capital; CARE AA; Stable upgrade) structurally relieved 88% pre-QIP non-fund-based limit saturation without promoter selling. Key operational watches from the November 2026 audit are: (1) earnings-quality normalization after 67% of Q2 FY27 post-forex EBITDA growth came from a non-normal Specialty Oils margin spike (₹23,262/KL on -20% volume) while conductor volume dipped 9.2% YoY and premium mix eased to 39.4%; (2) U.S. Section 232 and 54% non-metal reciprocal tariff asymmetry alongside ₹800 Cr of DDP transit inventory (Q2 U.S. revenue -29.7% YoY, cable exports -45.2% YoY); (3) single-source ACCC composite-core (CTC Global) and Jharsuguda molten-metal (Hindalco) supply dependencies; and (4) rising domestic competition from post-IBC Diamond Power Infrastructure (Q2 FY27 revenue +135% YoY; ₹3,735 Cr order book).
